scope: All twelve public main revisions pinned together at 2026-10-05T03:20:31.551004+00:00, with the vocabulary census, subsets and record statistics regenerated at those pins. The site audit records these pins and the live sources checked during the refresh. Merged-PR totals cover all twelve Mechs, culturebotai-claw and CultureBotAI.github.io. They are all-time GitHub counts queried during the refresh, rather than counts cut off at the pin time; the two supporting repositories are recorded separately from Mech record statistics in mech_stats.json. Card sources are published browsers, CultureMech's generated README inventory and DUFMech's frozen seed-family JSON. DUF seed families remain explicitly distinguished from curated mechanism records. All twelve pinned repositories contain CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, preserving upstream and historical terms. Capability declarations describe contract adoption, not a certification of complete validation coverage or blocking enforcement.

The published 73958ed snapshot declares 12 canonical fleet members, including DUFMech, 20 governed artifacts and 26 capabilities per member. This manifest-only refresh retains the October 5 Mech census, card and statistics pins; the 24 website-feature criteria are a separate evidence surface. DUFMech has 20 enabled, 3 disabled and 3 not_applicable canonical declarations, with reasons and settings preserved verbatim. Its enabled offline adapters include genuine OAK correspondence to frozen Pfam labels, retained-abstract knowledge-gap proposals and KGX/SSSOM exports. Knowledge-gap scheduled execution remains false; provider-backed deep research, METPO proposals and causal-graph coverage remain disabled. This governance-pin update does not claim scientific characterization, live source freshness or a full data refresh.

6,532 seed families in data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-01.json, validated against its frozen manifest: 4,533 UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE and 1,999 KNOWN_HISTORICAL_DUF. Each JSON row is one measured family; the TSV is a redundant serialization. Counts, heatmap occurrences and shared-term links measure this seed worklist without claiming curated mechanism records. Pfam and InterPro accessions are structured family identifiers. The repository includes a generated dashboard with all 6,532 families marked UNSCORED, but the checked public Pages URLs return 404. CLAW membership remains undeclared. The live interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-01.json is byte-identical to data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-01.json at the pin.
